meta.title: KERI Value System
meta.notes: Work in progress. Weights and links are subjective and adjustable. Node weight = importance (1-10), link weight = strength of relation (1-3).

nodes.label: Trustworthiness
nodes.description: The overarching value. Nearly every engineering principle ultimately serves to create trust.

nodes.label: Sovereignty
nodes.description: Trust that empowers people.

nodes.label: Freedom
nodes.description: Trust that protects people.

nodes.label: Resilience
nodes.description: Trust that survives adversity.

nodes.label: Universality
nodes.description: Trust that works universally.

nodes.label: Simplicity
nodes.description: Trust that remains understandable and composable.

nodes.label: Security First
nodes.description: Engineering principle: security before everything else.

nodes.label: End-to-End Verifiability
nodes.description: Engineering principle: everything verifiable to the root of trust.

nodes.label: Self-Sovereign Control
nodes.description: Engineering principle: control stays with the identity holder.

nodes.label: Contextual Confidentiality
nodes.description: Engineering principle: confidentiality appropriate to context.

nodes.label: Fault Tolerance
nodes.description: Engineering principle: anticipate and recover from failures.

nodes.label: Minimal Sufficiency
nodes.description: Engineering principle: minimally sufficient means.

nodes.label: Open by Design
nodes.description: Engineering principle: open source, open standards.

nodes.label: Scale by Design
nodes.description: Engineering principle: designed for global scale.

nodes.label: Real-World Governance
nodes.description: Engineering principle: model real-world authority and governance.

nodes.label: PERPETUAL
nodes.description: Perpetual persistent identity, crypto period, pre-rotation, hashed-not-signed, duplicity detection, self-associate data, reputation.

nodes.label: ENTROPY
nodes.description: Unbreakable, only bruteforceable, sufficient randomness, uncorrelatable, bulk issuances.

nodes.label: SECUFIRST
nodes.description: Security First sufficiently because you will have nothing when broken; fortify upfront (uncorrelatability); no intermediate infrastructure vulnerability.

nodes.label: SAFETY
nodes.description: Accountability, non-repudiation, end-to-end verifiability, verifiable to the root of trust, sign everything, no cross-context correlation. When in doubt, rotate out.

nodes.label: RECOUPEERS
nodes.description: Recourse on peers: accountability, no exploitation. Data errors hurt individuals; data can be weaponized against you.

nodes.label: NOSHARSECR
nodes.description: No shared secrets: shared secrets and you're done (by AI), no middlemen needed, no shared governance (blockchain).

nodes.label: MINIMSUFFI
nodes.description: Minimally sufficient (all others will converge to KERI), no partial KERI possible, no 'KERI Light', single source of truth.

nodes.label: FAULTTOL
nodes.description: Fault tolerant: anticipate breaches, theft, errors, and recover; cascade consequences; no single point of failure.

nodes.label: UNBROCHAIN
nodes.description: Unbroken chain of events (2 roots of trust, hash tree, blockchain), versioning and backward compatibility.

nodes.label: ATSCALE
nodes.description: Able to service global scale: omnipresent, any time, anyone, anywhere; interoperability by design.

nodes.label: GRALIFCONF
nodes.description: Gradual lifting of confidentiality: gradual disclosure depending on counterpart role, contextual display, selective disclosure.

nodes.label: AGNOSTIC
nodes.description: Cryptography agnostic, wallet agnostic, intermediate infrastructure agnostic, no vendor lock, versatility.

nodes.label: LEGOVPOL
nodes.description: Implementation/infrastructure for legal governance: laws, regulations, policies, (readable) Ricardian contracts.

nodes.label: SPACTRILL
nodes.description: Spac trilemma: no privacy without accountability, delegated guardian relationships, balanced through multi-sig authorizations.

nodes.label: ORGID
nodes.description: Organizational identity and root of trust: records of decisions, transfer of credential sets, legal mandates, delegation of tasks and responsibilities.

nodes.label: HARPROB1ST
nodes.description: Solve the hard problem first: get rid of complexity, solve problems others can't, get rid of username-passwords, truly portable identifiers.

nodes.label: REALMPRAGM
nodes.description: Realism/pragmatism: correlation is always on the web; accountable, not constraining; no hiding but 'no exploitation'; reduce troubles.

nodes.label: CANMODELRW
nodes.description: Can model real-world (authority) structures; all others can't. Asynchronous operation online/offline, sustain reputation.

nodes.label: OTHUNSAFE
nodes.description: Other systems are unsafe or insecure: leaking data, being ephemeral, producing false positives, false-negative profiling.

nodes.label: VERCOMTMT
nodes.description: Verifiable commitments to data, long-term non-repudiability, wrap and enrich other data formats, verifiable data graph.

nodes.label: ANTIFRAUD
nodes.description: The main stickiness factor that's compelling and contagious.

nodes.label: 1PERSCONTR
nodes.description: First person control, self-sovereign identity, no usernames and passwords, create personas, consent because transparency, no phone home.

nodes.label: ECONINFEA
nodes.description: Economically infeasible (to attack), decentralized enough, compensate current interests (data harvesters and aggregators).

nodes.label: NOUSEKERI
nodes.description: "Don't use KERISuite for these things": e.g. the conviction that fraud must be eradicated — fraud will always be there.

nodes.label: INCLUSIVE
nodes.description: All-encompassing spanning protocol, accessible for all people, most universal, open-source, open standards, free, comprehensive utility.

nodes.label: VERNOTVAL
nodes.description: Verify not validate: zero-trust environments, sign everything to be verified, proof and prove, less susceptible to fraud.

nodes.label: INCENCOOP
nodes.description: Incentivize cooperation in governance structure, tokenomics, in competition and making money, open and no vendor-lock.

nodes.label: PROVCONTXT
nodes.description: Provide and lock in context of the process: organizational binding and content, schemas, manage personal data/attributes, provably deterministic.

nodes.label: NOWSTACK
nodes.description: Stack features: "now we can ...", combinations of the above.

nodes.label: EASEOFUSE
nodes.description: Interoperability, meet customers where they are, reduce complication, hyper-churn your credentials.

nodes.label: BIZEFFCASE
nodes.description: Business and/or efficiency case: profit, cost reduction, risk reduction, endorsement lifts onboarding and research costs, single source of truth.

nodes.label: INFRASURF
nodes.description: Surf existing infrastructure: OOBIs via X.509, VVP on JWT in Telco, existing laws, existing programming logic (HIO), existing economic models (SEDI).

nodes.label: MARKETPEN
nodes.description: Market penetration: trust in the protocol, acceptance, interoperability with other protocols, bridge to legacy systems, flooding capacity.

nodes.label: GRASPEASY
nodes.description: Easy to explain, simple, clear — as opposed to complicated, not-ingrained concepts (platypus, elephant and blind men).

nodes.label: MATURITY
nodes.description: Weathered, complete, thoroughly tested, established, everywhere under the hood, higher-level coding and APIs.

nodes.label: COMMUNEDU
nodes.description: Community education: managing secrets, privacy non-existing, selective disclosure, self-association, provenance, security breach breaks all.
